what: Planned jq invocation uses -nsR with inputs, which produces no parsed event rows under jq raw-input behavior
scenario_or_breakage: Success fixtures and real Codex JSONL would fail closed, so no per-bucket ledger rows would ever be written
suggested_fix: Use jq -nR with inputs/fromjson? or another line-streaming form, and add a one-line JSONL fixture that must return the four KV lines

what: Plan maps input_tokens and cached_tokens into separate billed buckets without subtracting cache hits
scenario_or_breakage: If input_tokens is inclusive of cached tokens, cached tokens are charged once as full input and again as cached input, preserving inflated Codex cost despite removing BLENDED_WARN
suggested_fix: Set INPUT to max(input_tokens - cached_tokens, 0), CACHE_READ to cached_tokens, OUTPUT to output_tokens, and add an API-shaped fixture where input_tokens includes cached_tokens

what: Stdout split drops wrapper diagnostics and stdout auth text from the sidecar while classifiers still inspect only the sidecar
scenario_or_breakage: A Codex auth or failure message printed on stdout is routed to events JSONL, not classified as auth, and append-tool-failure loses the wrapper failure summary
suggested_fix: Demux stdout so JSON events go to the events file while non-JSON stdout remains in the sidecar, or classify failures against both sidecar and events stdout

what: Plan omits the actual launch-codex-implement harness update
scenario_or_breakage: Existing tests still expect the old argv shape and tokens used scraping, so make lint can fail or miss the new per-bucket path
suggested_fix: Update test-codex-implementer stubs/assertions for --json, events sidecars, per-bucket ledger rows, and include make test-codex-implementer in explicit validation

what: Stated wherever Codex is launched scope ignores direct codex exec call sites
scenario_or_breakage: User-visible direct Codex lanes keep no JSON/per-bucket capture, while health probes need an explicit exclusion, leaving partial coverage ambiguous
suggested_fix: Grep codex exec in the plan, classify each direct call as excluded probe or update it to use the helper/ledger; narrow the stated goal if only three launchers are intended

what: Existing script sibling docs are not included despite behavior changes
scenario_or_breakage: Docs continue to claim combined stdout/stderr sidecars and tokens used scraping after the launcher contract changes
suggested_fix: Add UPDATED entries for affected .md siblings and docs/linting.md so documentation matches the new stream and token-capture contracts
